links.comparator_used: Random sampling of AI-coded admissions for human review at the same 20% review rate (simulated)
links.outcome: Reduction in Coding Reimbursement Score (CRS) gap from human review of AI-assigned ICD-10-CM codes
links.effect: 43.2% CRS reduction with revenue-targeted prioritization vs 20.0% with random sampling at 20% review rate; reached 91% of the oracle bound
links.quote: At a 20% review rate, revenue-targeted prioritization achieved 43.2% CRS reduction versus 20.0% for random sampling, reaching 91% of the oracle bound.
